# Take Initiative on a Customer Pain Point

[← Amazon](../README.md) · [Every Amazon question](../../amazon.md) · [Read it on TrueInterview](https://trueinterview.io/study/take-initiative-on-a-customer-pain-point)

---

Tell about a customer problem you spotted and proactively solved.

### Constraints & Assumptions

Draw from an actual case and separate your own effort from what the group did. This document is the question, not a sample response; fictional anecdotes are used in the solution.

### Clarifying Questions

How did you discover the issue?
Which customers were impacted?
How did you confirm it was important and decide on a solution?
What outcome did the customer experience?

### What a Strong Answer Covers

Direct customer data, a clear articulation of the problem, how it was prioritized, a targeted fix, and proof that the experience improved.

### Follow-up Questions

How did you ensure you weren't generalizing from a single complaint?
What other solutions were on the table?
How did you verify the fix truly helped and didn't just shift the pain?

Overview: Describe a customer-driven action using concrete proof, a verified pain point, a specific intervention, and evidence that the customer's situation got better.
